notes: Pilot campaign pilot-bze2 (bh, rs; seeds 0-19; budget 40000). BH 6/20 and RS 2/20 runs reached the GM (energies agree to < 0.002 eV; found in symmetry-equivalent cage positions). 17 RS runs end at a distinct isomer +0.029-0.033 eV (different Cu6 shape) and the 14 unsuccessful BH runs are trapped at +0.115/+0.140 eV, so restarts/diversity matter. Final budget = 3 x median BH hit step (5558) = 16700 (BH SR 5/20 within it); e_tol 0.02: the isomer has a tight minimum (fmax 0.002) at +0.0287 eV and GM-basin runs re-relax to E_best. GM: compact 3D Cu6 (12 Cu-Cu bonds, CN 3-5, Cu-Cu 2.43 A) anchored to the aei cage wall (COM 3.3 A from the cage centre); 3 Cu each bind 2 framework O (Cu-O 2.05-2.18 A, Cu-Si 2.40 A); E_int = -3.4 eV (-0.57 eV/Cu); nearest periodic image 10.4 A. Framework (NEP89): Si-O 1.628 A, O-Si-O 109.47 +- 0.70 deg, V/T +1.1 % vs IZA, a true NEP89 minimum (rattle test), but -6.7 kJ/mol SiO2 vs alpha-quartz (NEP89 artefact; calorimetry gives +7 to +14 kJ/mol for all-silica zeolites). Cu9@AEI was dropped (BH SR 3/10 with median hit 29.7k steps -> ~90k-step budget, RS 0/10).
